Macklin Celebrini.summary: Celebrini scored two goals, one on an overtime power play, and added a power-play assist in Tuesday's 4-3 win over the Canadiens.
Celebrini scored a goal on seven shots and added two power-play assists in Saturday's 4-3 shootout loss to the Red Wings.

Evan Bouchard.summary: Bouchard scored a power-play goal on three shots and added a power-play assist in Tuesday's 4-3 overtime win over the Wild.
Bouchard notched two assists, including one on the power play, and added two hits, two blocked shots and a plus-2 rating in Tuesday's 4-1 win over the Kings.

Moritz Seider.summary: Seider notched two assists, two shots on goal, four hits and four blocked shots in Saturday's 4-3 shootout win over the Sharks.
Seider recorded a power-play assist, placed three shots on net, had four blocked shots and dished out a hit in Sunday's 3-2 loss to Winnipeg.

Jack Hughes.summary: Hughes scored the game-winning goal and added two assists, one on the power play, in Tuesday's 5-4 overtime victory over the Red Wings.
Hughes notched two power-play assists in Saturday's 4-1 win over the Canucks.

Cutter Gauthier.summary: Gauthier notched an assist and four shots on goal in Friday's 4-2 loss to the Bruins.
Gauthier (upper body) will be in the lineup to face Boston on Friday, Derek Lee of The Hockey News reports.
Cutter Gauthier.credit: Rotowire via ESPN, citing Derek Lee (The Hockey News)

Dylan Guenther.summary: Guenther scored a goal on two shots, added an assist, logged six PIM and went plus-2 in Tuesday's 5-4 win over the Maple Leafs.
Guenther scored a goal and added two assists, all on the power play, in Saturday's 4-1 win over the Blue Jackets.

Jakob Chychrun.summary: Chychrun scored a power-play goal, recorded an assist, placed three shots on net and served two PIM in Friday's 5-2 win over the Hurricanes.
Chychrun scored a power-play goal in Tuesday's 2-1 win over the Blue Jackets.

Alex Tuch.summary: Tuch scored twice on three shots, added an assist and went plus-2 in Wednesday's 5-4 win over the Canadiens.
Tuch scored a goal on six shots, blocked two shots and went plus-2 in Wednesday's 5-3 win over the Penguins.

Jeremy Swayman.summary: Swayman stopped 22 of 25 shots in Tuesday's 3-2 overtime loss to the Stars.
Swayman will tend the twine on the road against the Stars on Tuesday, Adam Pellerin of NESN reports.
Jeremy Swayman.credit: Rotowire via ESPN, citing Adam Pellerin (NESN)

Brandt Clarke.summary: Clarke scored a goal on six shots and added two PIM in Tuesday's 4-1 loss to the Oilers.
Clarke logged two assists, including one on the power play, and added five shots on goal, two blocked shots and a minus-2 rating in Saturday's 5-4 overtime loss to the Sharks.

Tom Wilson.summary: Wilson scored an empty-net goal on three shots in Friday's 3-1 win over the Rangers. He also added three hits.
Wilson scored a goal on two shots, added two assists, logged two hits, blocked two shots and went plus-3 in Wednesday's 5-3 win over the Penguins.

Connor Bedard.summary: Bedard scored a power-play goal on three shots and added an assist in Thursday's 4-3 overtime win over the Jets.
Bedard tallied a power-play assist, posted a plus-1 rating and placed three shots on net in Tuesday's 5-3 win over Pittsburgh.

Connor Hellebuyck.summary: Hellebuyck (suspension) is not listed on the Jets' official roster, per the NHL media site Friday.
Hellebuyck has been suspended by the Jets for not reporting to training camp Wednesday amid his ongoing confrontation with the team regarding his trade request.

Pavel Dorofeyev.summary: Dorofeyev scored a power-play goal Thursday in a 7-1 loss to New Jersey.
Dorofeyev registered a goal and an assist in Thursday's 5-1 win over the Lightning.

Mark Stone.summary: Stone scored a shorthanded goal on two shots in Tuesday's 6-2 loss to the Lightning.
Stone scored a power-play goal, added two assists and went plus-2 in Saturday's 6-2 win over the Penguins.

Justin Faulk.summary: Faulk scored a power-play goal on four shots, added two blocked shots and logged two PIM in Saturday's 4-3 shootout win over the Sharks.
Faulk scored the game-winning goal and added an assist in Tuesday's 5-3 win over Ottawa.

Jet Greaves.summary: Greaves allowed five goals on 19 shots in Tuesday before being replaced midway through the second period by Cam Talbot in a 6-2 loss to Toronto.
Greaves is slated to defend the home crease in Tuesday's clash against the Maple Leafs, per Mark Scheig of The Hockey Writers.
Jet Greaves.credit: Rotowire via ESPN, citing Mark Scheig (The Hockey Writers.)

Gavin McKenna.summary: McKenna scored a power-play goal on one shot in Monday's 3-1 win over the Sharks.
McKenna played 17:56 in Saturday's 4-1 loss to the Islanders. He registered four shots and finished minus-2.

Shea Theodore.summary: Theodore scored a goal and went plus-3 in Saturday's 6-2 win over the Penguins.
Theodore scored a goal on four shots and blocked two shots in Friday's 4-3 loss to the Ducks.

Joel Eriksson Ek.summary: Eriksson Ek scored a goal on eight shots in Tuesday's 4-3 overtime loss to the Oilers.
Eriksson Ek notched two assists, including one on the power play, and added three shots on net and four hits in Thursday's 5-4 win over the Blues.

Mikael Granlund.summary: Granlund didn't record a point while putting two shots on net with a minus-2 rating in Monday's 5-2 loss to the Rangers.
Granlund (upper body) is expected to play against the Rangers on Monday, per Zach Cavanagh of The Sporting Tribune.
Mikael Granlund.credit: Rotowire via ESPN, citing Zach Cavanagh (The Sporting Tribune.)

Mackenzie Blackwood.summary: Blackwood turned aside 21 shots in Monday's 3-2 loss to the Flyers.
Blackwood will start Monday's road game against Philadelphia, Adam Kimelman of NHL.com reports.
Mackenzie Blackwood.credit: Rotowire via ESPN, citing Adam Kimelman (NHL.com)

Jared McCann.summary: McCann ripped a power-play goal in Thursday's 4-3 overtime loss to the Lightning.
McCann scored a goal on two shots in Sunday's 5-3 win over the Capitals.

Carter Hart.summary: Hart stopped 15 of 21 shots in Tuesday's 6-2 loss to the Lightning.
Hart will start Tuesday's home matchup against Tampa Bay, per SinBin.vegas.
